affected_component: upstream_conformance.probe_runnable_nodes (+_candidate_execution_roots, --rootdir parity in precheck) + tool_pipeline freeze-time probe of a wider ranked candidate list
invariant: v1 invariant unchanged (only nodes compatible with the declared runner profile may be selected). v2: before a selection is frozen it is executed once, candidate by candidate in ranked order, with the same interpreter and admitted execution roots the rehearsal precheck uses; only ids that really pass (parameter ids included) are kept, a ModuleNotFoundError prunes every later candidate whose module-level imports name that module, nothing is installed, dropped nodes are recorded with the missing module, and an empty result is an honest empty selection rather than a frozen subset destined to block rehearsal. Both probe and precheck pass --rootdir=<upstream> so node ids and conftest discovery follow the suite itself.
